scientific_integrity: Analytic proof covers every real exponent and every admissible rule; numerical checks are supplemental. The main new phenomenon is the reentrant signed-error transition across p=4 and p=6; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed normalized positive one- or two-unoriented-direction rules in the plane; all real p>=2. At p=2 exactness is prior-covered. Supremum over convex bodies may require degenerating rectangles; no larger-node, signed-weight, or higher-dimensional claim. Search-based priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp two-view power-Cauchy error with reentrant sign transitions
